# TOPIC_ID · Descriptive topic title

::: {.chapter-lead}
**Learning targets:** concise student-facing objectives with current CED IDs.
:::

## Start with a question

Name the group, variable and purpose. Identify the dataset as synthetic or published.

## Develop the idea

Explain definitions in context before introducing notation. Include a worked example.

## Explore and explain

Use a purposeful accessible interaction or diagram. Preserve a static fallback and print state.

## Common mistakes

Explain the misconception and give a better interpretation.

## Practice

Add original questions with stable IDs and detailed revealable answers.

## Before moving on

Summarize what students should be able to do and link existing adjacent chapters only.

## Sources and scope

Record the CED edition, objective IDs, checked date and data/asset provenance. Separate extensions.
